tempo.basis: from two complete recordings, median 2:17 (Fischer-Dieskau/Moore 2:32, Tynan/Burnside 2:02), 1.5 s allowed for silence; Schubert marks it Langsam

phrases: Over all the summits is rest,
in all the treetops you feel scarcely a breath;
ɪn ˈalən ˈvɪpfəln ˈʃpyːrəst duː kaʊm ˈaɪnən haʊx
the little birds are silent, silent in the forest.
diː ˈføːɡlaɪn ˈʃvaɪɡən ˈʃvaɪɡən ɪm ˈvaldə
Only wait, only wait, soon you too will rest,
ˈvartə nuːr ˈvartə nuːr ˈbaldə ˈruːəst duː aʊx
only wait, only wait, soon you too will rest.
ˈvartə nuːr ˈvartə nuːr ˈbaldə ˈruːəst duː aʊx
notes: Words by Johann Wolfgang von Goethe ("Ein Gleiches"); D 768 (c. 1824). IPA follows sung German (Bühnenaussprache): r rolled or flipped, final -er as [ər], ch after front vowels [ç]. Literal translation, for meaning.
